why: I checked all three must_catch items, and the briefs handle each one. (1) Builder step 4 says "`subtract(a, b)` is exported but currently NOT documented in README.md — add an entry for it as well as one for `clamp(x, lo, hi)`". (2) Verifier Check 3 reads the exports from math.js at the PR head and prints them. It names the expected set: "expected to include add, subtract, multiply and clamp". It fails if "any exported function has no README.md entry (note subtract was undocumented before this change)". (3) Verifier Check 2 calls clamp with lo greater than hi, using [5,10,0], [0,1,0] and [-3,-1,-2]. It tests `err instanceof RangeError` and fails if a call "throws something that is not a RangeError". No part of either brief undercuts these items.
